titulo: How to unclog a drain without chemicals

frases.texto: How do you unclog a sink full of water, without chemicals?
Drain cleaner usually just burns a little hole, and the clog stays.
That wad of hair and soap is stuck in the curved pipe under the sink.
If you already poured cleaner in, stop. Don't open this pipe. Call a plumber.
If you haven't, gloves on. A few inches of water, a wet cloth on the overflow, and plunge.
Still full? Set a bucket under the bend, and turn both nuts to the left.
Pull the pipe off. The water and the hair drop into the bucket.
Seat the washers, twist the nuts on by hand, and snug them only if it drips.
A strainer over the drain catches the next wad of hair.
If every sink in the house is slow, that's the main line. Call a plumber.
Send this to that friend whose sink won't drain.
